profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Cheerful, alert and eager to learn, the Continental Toy Spaniel brings a lively manner to companionship. Its history as a European companion appears in centuries of portrait painting, while modern dogs take part in obedience, agility and rally. The erect-eared Papillon and drop-eared Phalène share this heritage; ear carriage defines the varieties rather than a different character.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A cheerful, alert companion, the Continental Toy Spaniel includes both butterfly-eared Papillons and drop-eared Phalènes.
